title: PV Sindhu Criticises Asian Games Badminton Scheduling for Recovery Issues
indian_angle: India's star shuttler PV Sindhu voiced concerns over the demanding schedule at the Asian Games, highlighting potential impacts on player performance and recovery.
summary: Two-time Olympic medallist PV Sindhu expressed her dissatisfaction with the badminton scheduling at the Asian Games 2026, citing insufficient recovery time between her matches.

title: India's Individual Badminton Campaign Ends at Asian Games After Quarterfinal Exits
indian_angle: India concluded its individual badminton campaign at the Asian Games 2026 without any medals, as top players like PV Sindhu and Unnati Hooda exited in the quarterfinals.
summary: Indian shuttlers, including PV Sindhu and Unnati Hooda, were eliminated in the quarterfinals of their respective individual events at the Asian Games 2026, marking the end of India's medal hopes in these categories.

title: Treesa-Gayatri, Dhruv-Tanisha Bow Out in Asian Games Doubles Quarterfinals
indian_angle: India's doubles pairs, Treesa Jolly/Gayatri Gopichand and Dhruv Kapila/Tanisha Crasto, concluded their Asian Games journey after losing their quarterfinal matches.
summary: Indian women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, along with mixed doubles pair Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto, were defeated in their respective quarterfinal matches at the Asian Games 2026.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships 2026 Begins
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has commenced a national coaching camp at NCE, Guwahati, to prepare players for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Organizes Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting an Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course at its National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for grooming India's young talents for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati.
